facts.text: The large upper hero panel shows a massive black dragon in a left-facing profile, with a long horned head, spiked dorsal ridge, a long tail, and large bat-like wings extending to the right.
In the hero panel, the dragon stands on all fours with its head lowered over dark reflective wet ground, surrounded by jagged rock formations, smoky air, and scattered glowing orange embers.
The dragon has charcoal-black scales with blue-cyan iridescent highlights, long pale tan backward-swept horns, numerous facial and neck spikes, and large pale claws.
A lower turnaround panel labeled FRONT shows the dragon facing the viewer with its wings spread wide and its long tail visible behind it.
A lower turnaround panel labeled SIDE PROFILE shows the dragon in profile with its wings partly spread and its long spiked tail extending behind it.
A lower turnaround panel labeled REAR shows the dragon from behind with its wings spread and its tail extending downward between its legs.
A bottom-row close-up labeled HEAD CLOSE shows the dragon's horned face, textured scales, and an amber-colored eye.
A bottom-row detail labeled WING MEMBRANE shows the dark, ribbed, leathery wing surface with visible supporting fingers.
A bottom-row detail labeled CLAW AND FOOT shows a scaly dragon foot with large curved pale claws.
A bottom-row detail labeled SCALE DETAIL shows overlapping dark scales with blue-cyan highlights.
The image is a composite character reference sheet with one large hero panel across the top and six smaller labeled panels arranged in two rows below.
Visible panel labels read: FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, REAR, HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, and SCALE DETAIL.

card.summary: Dark fantasy dragon character reference sheet on a black background. A large hero panel shows a black, horned, bat-winged dragon in a volcanic landscape, with six labeled turnaround and detail panels below.

subjects.descriptor: Massive black dragon with long swept-back horns, spiked dorsal ridge, large bat-like wings, long tail, and pale claws.
attributes: spikes along the head, neck, back, and tail
large leathery bat-like wings with visible wing fingers
large clawed feet with pale claws
pose: Hero panel: standing on all fours with head lowered and wings partially extended
FRONT panel: facing viewer with wings spread
SIDE PROFILE panel: standing in profile with wings partly spread
REAR panel: viewed from behind with wings spread

card.environment: Hero panel: dark volcanic terrain with jagged rock spires, smoky air, reflective wet ground, and glowing orange embers. Turnaround and detail panels use a plain dark backdrop.
card.lighting: Low-key dramatic lighting with cool grey-blue highlights on the scales, warm orange ember glow in the background, and deep shadows.
card.framing: Composite reference sheet: a wide hero panel across the top and six smaller panels in two rows below, showing front, side profile, rear, head close, wing membrane, claw and foot, and scale detail views.
card.style: Dark fantasy creature concept art; photorealistic 3D-rendered character reference sheet.
card.characterisation: A colossal, menacing black dragon with long horns, armored scales, a spiked dorsal ridge, and expansive bat-like wings.

limitations: Some shadowed portions of the dragon and the volcanic background are difficult to resolve in detail.
The image is a still reference sheet; no motion, sound, or dialogue can be observed.
